hook: Six regional U.S. banks failed in 2026, marking the highest count of any year this decade.

sections.voiceover: Six regional U.S. banks failed in 2026, marking the highest count of any year this decade.
On January 30th, the Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation ordered Metropolitan Capital Bank and Trust to cease operations due to unsafe financial conditions.
These six failed banks held roughly 1.4 billion dollars in total value.
Financial news outlet Disruption Banking confirms these six banks held just 1.4 billion dollars total. Nano Banc became the sixth U.S. bank to fail in 2026 on September 25th.
Nano Banc holds 736 million dollars in assets.
